d:
Uttar pradesh ki siyasat ko lekar tejasvi yadav ne bari bhavishyavani ki hai. unhonne kaha ki aagami yupi vidhanasbha chunav men akhilesh yadav mukhyamantri banenge. tejasvi ke is bayan ke bad yupi ki rajniti men samajvadi parti aur akhilesh yadav ke netritv ko lekar charcha tej ho gaee hai. aakhir tejasvi yadav ko kyon bharosa hai ki yupi men akhilesh yadav ki sarkar banegi? dekhie puri khabar.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
